title: Every ia refusal names a next command
summary: Every consumer refusal of the ia CLI now names one next command: it is printed after the message and carried as a non-empty next string in --json output, including the IA-CLI-INTERRUPTED object. A refusal whose cause has no remedy of its own falls back to the refused command's --help for a usage failure (IA-CLI-USAGE) and to ia doctor otherwise. Automation that read next as nullable can now rely on a string. The machine protocol's refusal shape is unchanged.
